newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates quoted steady on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates quoted steady on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady levels on Friday at the St. Louis Merchants Exchange. No barges traded on Friday versus none on Thursday.
- Two barges, next week, Osceola through Cairo, Mississippi River, bid 117-1/2 percent of tariff, offered 130 percent.
- Two barges, next week, Illinois River, bid 155 percent, offered one barge at 165 percent.
One barge, next week, lower Ohio River, no bid, offered 140 pecent.
- Three barges, one each week of January 12-26, St Louis, Mississippi River, bid 110 percent, offered 115 percent, unchanged from Thursday.
- Six barges, two each week of January 12-26, Illinois River, no bid, offered 200 percent.
- Eight barges, two each week of February, Osceola through Cairo, Mississippi River, no bid, offered 100 percent.
- Eight barges, two each week of February, Ohio River, no bid, offered 120 percent.
